analysis.insight_summary: Users want clear information about connecting older and newer versions of [product_name] base and expansion modules. A main concern is the lack of backward compatibility for some article numbers, which can lead to confusion during upgrades or when expanding existing systems.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward compatibility between older expansion modules and newer [product_name] base modules, or, at minimum, transparent instructions on how to connect them.
